sample_unit: ChatGPT responses (10 diagnoses x 4 educational categories)

links.outcome: Readability (FRE, FKGL) of ChatGPT patient education responses versus 7th-8th grade target
links.effect: Responses were at a college graduate reading level: mean FRE 25.64 and median FKGL 12.61, above the recommended seventh to eighth grade level.
links.quote: The ChatGPT responses demonstrated a college graduate reading level, as indicated by the mean FRE score of 25.64 and the median FKGL score of 12.61.

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of ChatGPT patient education responses
links.effect: Mean FRE 25.64 and median FKGL 12.61 indicate college graduate reading level, not plain language for average American patients.
links.quote: The ChatGPT responses demonstrated a college graduate reading level, as indicated by the mean FRE score of 25.64 and the median FKGL score of 12.61.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline performance, appropriateness, and readability for patient primary care queries without testing specific organizational deployment safeguards or practices.
